name: Human
description: The default race. Balanced stats, no surprises. Can re-roll at the Mirror Shrine.
upgrades: V2: +5% movement speed and stamina regen.
V3: Unlocks limit-break — once per life, ignore one CC effect.

name: Fishman
passive: Move at full speed underwater; +20% HP regen near sea
description: Born of the ocean. Fishmen breathe underwater and gain stat boosts at sea.
upgrades: V3: Tidal Aura — allies near you regen HP.

name: Skypiean
passive: +25% air time on jumps; reduced fall damage
description: Citizens of the sky. Lighter bodies and faster air movement.
upgrades: V3: Sky Dash — once per fight, teleport upward 30 studs.

name: Mink
passive: Sprint 15% faster; melee crits restore stamina
description: Beast-folk of the Mokomo Highlands. Pair with Electro for the iconic combo.
upgrades: V2: Sulong — under a full moon, +30% damage and HP.

name: Cyborg
passive: Energy never drops below 25%; +10% damage resist
description: Augmented body. Trades organic recovery for raw consistency.
upgrades: V2: Overdrive — 8s of +30% attack speed, once per battle.
V3: Reactor — unlocks built-in dash and ranged blast.

name: Ghoul
passive: Gain HP on takedowns; aura inflicts fear at low HP
description: A cursed bloodline. Strongest in chaos — weakest in peace.
upgrades: V2: Shadow Step — short blink at <50% HP.
V3: Devour — finisher heals to full on kill (180s CD).
